column1: # v45 probe: injuries (a cut, a wound, blood flowing, a bandage), deaths from various causes (an arrow, a sword, a
# snakebite, the heart, an illness in bed, an accident, old age) with mourning and the white sheet, and places and
# situations the director was never told about — modern (the hospital, the office, the metro, the mall, the airport,
# the gym, the classroom, the restaurant, a video call, a delivery) and old (the village well, the fields, the potter's
# wheel, the temple, the river ghat, the battlefield, the old bazaar, a letter by pigeon, a bullock cart).
# Run by tools/jvm/com/tarun/kahani/jvm/PhenomenaProbe.java (v45 codes: DEAD — the main character dies in the window;
# MOURN — someone else on the stage weeps in it).
